## Summary

Describe the user problem and the focused change that solves it.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] Relevant workflows tested manually
- [ ] Mobile layout checked when UI changed
- [ ] Print preview checked when calendar layout changed
- [ ] Documentation updated when behavior or data changed

## Review notes

Call out important tradeoffs, accessibility considerations, storage or URL-format changes, and any follow-up work that is intentionally outside this pull request.
